nodes.label: Graphify Knowledge Graph Tool
nodes.rationale: Provides scoped subgraph queries (query/path/explain) that are usually much smaller than reading GRAPH_REPORT.md or raw grep/source output, keeping codebase-question context small.

nodes.label: Ponytail Mode (Rigorous Code Auditor persona)
nodes.rationale: Invoked as a debugging-prompt persona so root-cause fixes are provided without introducing temporary hacks or side effects.

nodes.label: Clean Architecture Pattern
nodes.rationale: Separates code into data/domain/presentation layers so business logic cannot leak into the UI, keeping AI-generated code consistent and testable across sessions.

nodes.label: Feature-First Directory Structure
nodes.rationale: Organizes code by feature module (each with data/domain/presentation) rather than by type, so an AI agent always knows exactly where to place new files.

nodes.label: Mermaid.js Diagramming
nodes.rationale: Used for system architecture and user-flow visualizations so both the human and the AI keep a shared mental model of the system.

nodes.label: 8pt Grid Spacing System
nodes.rationale: Quantifies spacing to multiples of 8 so the AI does not invent arbitrary padding/margin values when generating UI code.

nodes.label: Standard API Response Format
nodes.rationale: Defines one consistent success/error envelope ({status,message,data} / {status,code,message,details}) so client interceptors can parse every endpoint uniformly.

nodes.label: Anti-Hallucination Clarify-First Principle
nodes.rationale: Instructs the AI to stop and ask clarifying questions rather than guess whenever requirements, KPIs, endpoints, or scope are vague, ambiguous, or contradictory, to prevent hallucinated features, packages, or endpoints.
